title: The Iron Biscuit
subtitle: A Curious Case Lands at Byomkesh’s Door
summary: On a lazy Sunday afternoon, an unexpected visitor brings a perplexing problem to detective Byomkesh Bakshi. As Kamal Babu unravels his tale of trouble and intrigue, a seemingly simple case quickly hints at deeper mysteries. Step into the heart of Calcutta to uncover what lies behind the enigmatic Iron Biscuit.
